messages:
Natalie: Quick Athens region readiness sync — are we green to schedule cutover for Fri (03/20)? Owners please reply with blockers and ETA.
Miguel: net: firewall changes are in CR, PR#5234 awaiting review for egress rules. @Sara can you run the NAT/egress probe from the bastion?
Sara: On it. kicking off `curl -I https://health.redwood.example` from athens-bastion now, will paste headers.
infra-bot: Probe result: 200 OK — latency 120ms (athens-bastion -> health.redwood.example). Timestamp 3864123520.
Tom: SRE: alerting dashboards wired up, but we still need a short runbook with escalation list. @Natalie where's the Athens runbook draft?
Natalie: Draft runbook here: https://go/athens-runbook (WIP) — I'll add escalations. Scheduling oncall run-through Wed 09:00 UTC.
Priya: Security: KMS key policy needs legal signoff for cross-region replica. Legal asked for exact SLA wording. @Aisha can legal do a quick review by Thu?
Aisha: Legal: I can do a review today but need the final KMS policy text. @Priya please paste the policy gist here.
Priya: KMS policy gist: `Principal: redwood-service@athens; Allow: Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey; Deny: ExternalAccountAccess`. Also rotation schedule included.
Aisha: Looks OK at high level — minor wording tweaks. I'll upload a redlined version to drive and ping once done.
Miguel: Network update: egress static IPs allocated: 34.76.12.7 and 34.76.12.8 — please add to partner allowlists. Also ACM cert for NLB still pending issuance but should be issued in ~30m.
Sara: Added IPs to partner allowlist and notified partner security. Cert is now issued, uploading to SSM parameter store.
Natalie: Outstanding blockers summary: (1) PR#5234 net tests (Miguel/Sara) — in progress; (2) KMS signoff (Priya/Aisha) — in review; (3) DB replica bootstrap blocked on infra PR#5261 (eng-infra) — need owner/ETA.
Luca: Eng-infra here — owning PR#5261, CI green, will try to merge tomorrow morning and run smoke after merge.
Miguel: Note: routing policy needs `region-prefer` flag so latency routing prefers Athens for EU-internal traffic. There's a small fallback bug logged as issue #948 (assigning to @Vikram).
Vikram: Taking #948 now, will push a patch and smoke today.
Natalie: Action items: (A) @Luca merge PR#5261 by 09:00 Thu; (B) @Miguel/@Sara confirm NAT + egress tests by EOD Wed; (C) @Priya deliver KMS doc to @Aisha today; (D) @Vikram land routing fallback fix by EOD. If all green, target Fri cutover. :thumbsup:
Tom: Can we schedule a 30-min smoke window Fri 10:00 UTC? I'll be oncall and can run chaos-free smoke.
Natalie: Added calendar invite for Fri 10:00 UTC — invite sent to eng-platform and oncall.
Sara: Running smoke now — `athens-bastion -> s3 PUT` succeeded. DB bootstrap hit timeout on replica init (see logs), tagging @Luca.
Luca: Saw the timeout, looks like IAM role wasn't attached in the account for the replica. Pushing a fix to PR#5261 now and re-running init after merge.
Miguel: PR#5234 review completed and merged. NAT/egress tests passed end-to-end. :rocket:
Priya: KMS document uploaded to drive, pinged @Aisha. Also flagged that enterprise tenants will need HSM integration — will coordinate next week.
Aisha: Redlined KMS doc uploaded. One legal suggestion: key rotation window — recommend 30 days for initial rollouts instead of 90. Leaving a comment in the doc.
Natalie: I prefer 30 days for the initial rollout window. Noted. Thanks all — I'll post the final checklist tomorrow morning.
